## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user/developer problem and the effect of this change. Link the issue or acceptance criteria.

## Validation

List commands and results, environment/version and any checks not run. For documentation-only changes, verify paths, commands and claims against the source.

## Compatibility and rollout

Identify affected consumers, configuration/data changes and rollback if applicable. State whether this changes deployed behavior. Include screenshots only when they help review a UI change.
